question: For each school, show the number of degree-granting departments, the number of subject codes attached to those departments, and the average total units of subjects offered in academic year 2024. SELECT 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS catalog_subject_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS offered_subject_count
FROM 
    sis_subject_code AS sc
LEFT JOIN 
    course_catalog_subject_offered AS cso
    ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN 
    subject_offered_summary AS sos
    ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
GROUP BY 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY 
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
